subject: Renewal: SLO package consolidation & premium response offering
messages:
From: Alice Wu <alice@quantix.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal conversation — premium SLA & capacity bump

Hi Irene,

Quick note as we're starting our renewal planning for Quantix — our contract ends June 30 and we want to discuss upgrading to a premium support + latency SLO package for the next term. Usage has grown 3x and the burst patterns during batch jobs are starting to hit our current capacity reservations.

Top asks:
- Latency SLO commitment: p95 < 250ms for the token sizes we discussed (avg 120 tokens) during standard hours
- Dedicated burst capacity for nightly reindex windows (up to 2.5x base throughput for 2 hours)
- 12–24 month term options with preferential pricing if we commit to 24 months
- A one-time ops credit to offset migration/runbook work

We can share a short usage export if that helps sizing. Ben (cc'd) will join any technical calls. Can you outline what a bundled premium offering would look like (SLOs, oncall, credits, pricing/term options)?

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Wu
Head of ML Platform, Quantix
(Attachment: Quantix_usage_202603.csv [csv, 120KB])
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — premium SLA & capacity bump

Hi Alice — thanks for the note and the heads-up on timelines. Happy to put a concrete package together. High-level proposal below; attaching a redline term sheet and an ops runbook we recommend for the first 90 days.

Summary proposal (we'll refine once we see the usage export):
- Premium SLO bundle: p95 latency target of 250ms for standard hours (tiered SLO for peak/off-peak), 99.5% availability SLA, 24/7 priority support with 1-hour P1 response
- Burst capacity: configurable burst pool that supports 2.5x base throughput for scheduled windows; we can reserve a portion as guaranteed burst capacity for critical jobs
- Term options: 12-month (standard) or 24-month (discounted) with an additional 3% discount for annual prepay
- One-time ops credit: we can propose a $15k credit to support runbook migration and a joint on-call onboarding sprint (subject to approval)

Attachments: Quantix_MA_Revision_20260414.pdf (term sheet, redline), ops_runbook_v2.docx (runbook template).

Next steps: 1) Send usage export; 2) I'll schedule a 30–45m call with Karthik to size burst and latency profiles; 3) I'll loop in Marissa for credit approval once we have a confirmed proposal.

On the call I'll cover: traffic shape, tail latency contributors, caching opportunities (prefix/KV caching) and quantization tradeoffs to reduce cost during peak.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Quantix_MA_Revision_20260414.pdf [pdf, 1.2 MB]; ops_runbook_v2.docx [docx, 220 KB])

Hi Alice / Irene — looping in some technical detail to help sizing. Based on the burst request and 120-token avg:
- For p95 < 250ms we recommend reserving an additional 1.8x of peak serving capacity and enabling aggressive prefix caching for inference jobs that repeat prompts
- For scheduled nightly reindex bursts: recommend configuring a burst policy (scheduled window) that temporarily increases per-GPU batch sizes and allocates a dedicated burst pool — this avoids impacting standard traffic
- If cost is a concern, we can combine quantized model variants for non-critical batch workloads (same quality envelope but ~30–40% lower GPU cost)

I'll prepare a sizing spreadsheet if you can share 2–3 weeks of 5m-sampled traffic (timestamps + token counts). Also attaching an ops checklist snippet in the runbook for the scheduled burst onboarding.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Alice — thanks for the export (helpful). Based on the 3 weeks you sent and Karthik's sizing, here's a concrete offer for renewal: 

Offer summary (term sheet attached):
- Term: 24 months (preferred) with 10% platform discount. 12-month option at list price available.
- SLOs: p95 < 250ms during standard hours (M–F 8am–8pm PT), p95 < 450ms during off-peak. Availability SLA 99.5% monthly.
- Support: 24/7 priority (1h P1 response), named technical lead for first 90 days, weekly onboarding checkpoints for 6 weeks.
- Burst capacity: guaranteed burst pool up to 2.5x base throughput for two scheduled windows per day (up to 2 hours each) plus on-demand burst up to 1.5x subject to capacity availability.
- Credits: requesting a $15k one-time ops credit; pending manager approval.
- Deliverables: joint runbook, oncall rotation onboarding, three reconciliation checkpoints (30/60/90 days).

Doc links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890), DocuSign envelope (https://www.docusign.com/tx/DOCDOC-4567).

If this aligns, I can send a formal quote and DocuSign. Marissa — can you confirm the one-time $15k ops credit? If approved we can include it in the quote and lock the 24-month discounted pricing.
